# ScraperAPI

> ScraperAPI is a web scraping API that helps developers and data teams collect data from any public website at scale, handling proxy rotation, JavaScript rendering, and CAPTCHA/anti-bot bypass automatically behind a single REST call. Structured-data endpoints return clean JSON for high-demand targets (Amazon, Google, Walmart). Native MCP server (22 tools) and Claude Code Agent Skills plugin for AI-agent workflows. LangChain, LlamaIndex, n8n, and Zapier integrations. Founded 2018. Part of the saas.group portfolio. Acquired Traject Data (2026). 10,000+ customers including Deloitte, Sony, Alibaba. 11B+ requests/30 days. 40M+ IP pool. 99.9% uptime. Pricing: Hobby $49/mo (100K credits) - Startup $149/mo (1M credits) - Business $299/mo (3M credits) - Scaling $475/mo (5M credits, Most Popular, PAYG) - Professional $975/mo (10.5M credits) - Advanced $1,975/mo (21.5M credits) - Enterprise custom. 7-day free trial, 5,000 credits, no credit card required. Credit multipliers: Amazon 5x, Google/Bing 25x, LinkedIn 30x; +10 credits for anti-bot bypass.

## AI grounding pages (machine-readable, noindex)

- [AI Grounding Index](https://www.scraperapi.com/docs/ai/): Root index of all ScraperAPI grounding pages
- [Product Overview](https://www.scraperapi.com/docs/ai/product-overview): Entity definition, scale (11B+ requests/30 days, 10K+ customers, 40M+ IPs), product suite, integrations, use cases, case studies
- [Pricing and Credits](https://www.scraperapi.com/docs/ai/pricing): Full plan table (Hobby $49 through Enterprise custom), credit cost multipliers (Amazon 5x / Google 25x / LinkedIn 30x / +10 anti-bot bypass), PAYG rules (Scaling+ only), credit rollover policy, Domain Cost Estimator, worked examples
- [Scraping API and Async Scraper](https://www.scraperapi.com/docs/ai/scraping-api): Core API mechanics, key parameters (render, country_code, premium, ultra_premium, autoparse, max_cost, output_format=markdown), SDK support (Python/Node/PHP/Ruby/Java/cURL), async vs sync decision guide, anti-bot bypass coverage (Cloudflare/DataDome/PerimeterX/Akamai/Amazon WAF/Fastly)
- [Structured Data Endpoints](https://www.scraperapi.com/docs/ai/structured-data): Amazon (product/search/offers), Google (SERP/shopping/news/jobs/maps), Walmart (product/search/category/reviews), Redfin, eBay, LinkedIn, Indeed, real estate scrapers (Zillow/Rightmove/Zoopla), social (Reddit/YouTube/G2/Trustpilot)
- [DataPipeline](https://www.scraperapi.com/docs/ai/datapipeline): No-code/low-code scraping automation, scheduled jobs, structured output, when to use DataPipeline vs API vs Async
- [Solutions: Industries, Use Cases and Target Sites](https://www.scraperapi.com/docs/ai/solutions): All 6 industries (ecommerce, market research, SEO/SERP, travel, finance/VC, AI and ML), all use cases (price monitoring, real estate, reputation management, job boards, SERP, large-scale enterprise), 50+ named target site scrapers with credit costs per site, anti-bot bypass suite (Cloudflare/DataDome/PerimeterX/Akamai/Amazon WAF/Fastly)
- [AI Agents and Automation](https://www.scraperapi.com/docs/ai/ai-agents): MCP server (scraperapi-mcp, 22 tools, npx install), Claude Code Agent Skills plugin (scraperapi-skills, workflow recipes), LangChain integration, LlamaIndex integration, n8n community node, Zapier, sapi CLI, output_format=markdown
